entities.name: A0A1T4LJG1 TpPycTM
observations: Exact sequence match to the 115-aa query; reviewed Swiss-Prot reference from Treponema porcinum.
Pycsar clade C effector protein in a two-gene pyrimidine cyclase antiphage-resistance system.
Annotated as a cell inner-membrane multi-pass protein that probably impairs membrane integrity after activation by cUMP.
Reference transmembrane helices span residues 44–64 and 74–94.

entities.name: Query 115-aa membrane effector
observations: Length 115 aa; estimated molecular mass 12.98 kDa; predicted pI 7.71; GRAVY 0.634.
Exact sequence match to UniProt A0A1T4LJG1, supporting direct transfer of the curated annotation.
Hydrophobic segments are consistent with at least two transmembrane helices, with a short N-terminal soluble region and membrane-embedded C-terminal portion.

entities.name: Pycsar antiphage system
observations: Pyrimidine cyclase system for antiphage resistance; the adjacent PycC enzyme produces cyclic nucleotide second messengers that activate the membrane effector.
Activation is associated with abortive phage infection and bacterial cell death.

entities.name: Abortive phage infection
observations: The Pycsar effector is annotated to provide bacteriophage immunity by impairing membrane integrity and causing bacterial cell death after cognate cyclic-nucleotide signaling.
